# Stop Hook Overhead Audit (FR-8a) -- 2026-08-01

Scope: `hooks/stop_notifier/core.py` (`main()`), `post_impl.py`, `voice.py`. The Stop
hook is RETAINED in the settings.json change set; this is an overhead measurement, not
a deletion-impact analysis. Source: static trace of `docs/phase-0-reverse-engineering/
ast_call_graph.json` + direct read of the three files (line numbers cited below).
Phase 0.1's `audit_surface.json` counted 17 subprocess spawn SITES inside
`hooks/stop_notifier/` -- this file distinguishes SITES from PER-TURN spawn COUNT, per
the task's explicit warning that the two are not interchangeable.

## Finding: unconditional per-turn spawns

Exactly **2** subprocess calls are unconditional -- no `if` guard of any kind wraps them,
so they fire on every single Stop event with zero exceptions:

| Site | Call |
|---|---|
| `post_impl.py:55` (`_create_pr_from_pipeline_data`, first statement) | `subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"], ...)` |
| `post_impl.py:208` (`_run_post_implementation_steps`, first statement) | `subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"], ...)` |

Both are called unconditionally from `core.py:490-494` (`_run_post_implementation_steps()`
then `_create_pr_from_pipeline_data()`), with no gating `if` before either call.

## Finding: file-existence-gated spawns (structurally conditional, behaviorally
## always-true in a normal checkout of this repo)

Six scripts in `core.py`'s `main()` are gated only on `<script_path>.exists()` -- a
repo-content check, not a session-state or runtime-data check. In a fully configured
checkout of this repo (the only kind that ships), all six paths exist, so these fire on
effectively every turn:

| Line | Script | Retry loop |
|---|---|---|
| 82 | `git-auto-commit-policy.py --enforce` | up to 3 attempts |
| 111 | `auto-save-session.py --project <name>` | up to 3 attempts |
| 139 | `archive-old-sessions.py` | up to 3 attempts |
| 163 | `session-pruner.py --max-age 30 --keep-min 10` | up to 3 attempts |
| 197 | `common-failures-prevention.py --analyze` | up to 3 attempts |
| 222 | `preference-auto-tracker.py` | single call, no retry |

That is **6 to 16 further subprocess spawns per turn** (6 if every script succeeds on its
first attempt, up to 16 if all five retry-capable scripts exhaust 3 attempts).

**Measured floor: 2 (unconditional) + 6 (file-exist-gated, minimum) = 8 raw subprocess
spawns per Stop-hook firing** in the common case where nothing else is happening this
turn. This is higher than the "4+ subprocesses/turn" figure in the architecture docs
(`hooks/stop_notifier/core.py:44-61`'s own docstring) -- that figure appears to undercount
even the always-on floor, before any session-state-conditional paths fire at all.

## Finding: genuinely session-state-conditional spawns -- NOT measured here, cannot
## be measured statically

These sites depend on runtime session state (a flag file existing, being on a specific
git branch, plan mode having been used, a prior PR-merge attempt having failed) that
static analysis cannot resolve to a per-turn probability. Enumerated for completeness,
explicitly left unmeasured:

| Line/file | Condition | Spawns if triggered |
|---|---|---|
| `core.py:243` (`plan-session-archiver.py`) | plan mode was used this session (`_plan_session_id` truthy) | up to 3 |
| `core.py:349` | `.pr-workflow-retry` flag file exists (a previous PR merge failed) | 1 `git branch --show-current` + possibly a full PR workflow |
| `core.py:377,422,432` (Priority 4 branch-based PR detection) | `not pr_triggered` (Priorities 1-3b did not already fire), then nested on branch/commit/clean-tree state | 1-3 `git` calls |
| `post_impl.py:64` / `post_impl.py:216` | not on `main`/`master`/`HEAD`/`""` (i.e. on a feature branch) | 1 `git rev-list --count` each |
| `voice.py:164` (`subprocess.Popen`, detached `voice-notifier.py`) | a PID-isolated voice flag file exists (`spoke_something` path) | 1 detached process |

The task brief's premise that voice-notifier.py launches "always, every turn" is **not
supported by the trace**: `handle_voice_flag()` (and therefore `voice.py:164`'s
`subprocess.Popen`) only runs when one of the three PID-isolated flag files
(`.session-start-voice-{PID}`, `.task-complete-voice-{PID}`, `.session-work-done-{PID}`)
or its legacy shared-flag fallback exists. Most Stop events are silent
(`core.py:487-488`: "No voice flags found (normal, most stops are silent)").

## Summary

| Category | Count | Measured? |
|---|---|---|
| Unconditional | 2 | Yes -- exact |
| File-existence-gated (effectively always-on) | 6 scripts, 6-16 spawns | Yes -- floor exact, ceiling depends on retry outcomes |
| Session-state-conditional | up to 9 more sites | No -- requires runtime telemetry, not available from static analysis |

**Plainly stated: the only two numbers this audit establishes with certainty are the
unconditional floor (2) and the file-existence-gated tier (6 scripts, minimum 6 spawns).
Everything above roughly 8 spawns/turn depends on session state this audit cannot
observe statically.**
